questions.location: Q1: Where did the accident happen? (e.g., a signaled intersection, an urban parking lot, a highway mainline, etc.)
questions.signal: Q2: What was the traffic signal situation? (The signal color for both the pedestrian and the vehicle, and whether the signal changed)
questions.pedestrian: Q3: Do the pedestrian or driver have any attributes that might affect the fault ratio, such as being a young child, elderly, having a disability, or being under the influence of alcohol?
questions.vehicles: Q4: How many vehicles were involved, what types are they, and what details do you know (manufacturer, model, year, etc.)?
questions.extra: Q5: Are there any other circumstances that might affect the fault ratio (e.g., speeding, poor visibility, nighttime)?
